reason: A WeChat integration for chatting with, monitoring, and approving DeepSeek Harness agent sessions through an unofficial iLink gateway, with allowlisting, session commands, digests, and in-chat permission responses.

summaries.zh: 通过非官方 iLink 网关将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体连接到微信，支持消息交互、会话管理、状态摘要和权限审批。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to WeChat through the unofficial iLink gateway for messaging, session management, status digests, and permission approvals.

capabilities: Connects a DeepSeek Harness agent profile to a WeChat personal account through the iLink gateway
Receives allowlisted WeChat text messages and routes them to active or newly created agent sessions
Sends agent responses, status updates, digests, errors, and stop notifications to WeChat
Displays agent permission requests in WeChat and relays user approvals or denials
Performs QR login, authenticated polling, reconnect handling, message retries, and rate limiting through the gateway
